curves.name: 5.6 V-class zener characteristic
curves.test_conditions: TA = 25 degC; typical family trace for the 5.6 V-class device

extraction_notes: The plotted curve is the 5.6 V-class trace in the family graph; points are digitized from the visible line in Fig. 2 and reported in SI units.
The 1SMA5919A table gives minimum, nominal, and maximum VZ values of 5.32 V, 5.60 V, and 5.88 V at IZT = 66.9 mA; the nominal value is recorded.
Fig. 5 capacitance curves were not used because they are generic family curves and do not identify an unambiguous 1SMA5919A value; capacitance is omitted.
No reverse-recovery specification is published in the supplied datasheet.
omission_reason: No target-specific capacitance value or reverse-recovery specification is published; Fig. 5 is a generic family capacitance plot without an unambiguous 1SMA5919A trace.
